# Sanatani Bandhan

> Sanatani Bandhan is an offline-first ERP and community super app for Sanatana Dharma institutions — Mandir, Goshala, Ashram, Gurukul, trusts, tirthas and 17 organisation types in all. It runs an institution's treasury, devotees, sevas, festivals and community in one workspace, with a hash-chained tamper-evident audit history, a public Transparency Board, and a Universal Sanatani ID for every devotee. Free plan available; works on any phone, even with no internet.

## What it is

- One workspace per institution: treasury (donations, expenses, 80G receipts), devotee records, seva and puja bookings, festivals, assets, and team roles.
- Offline-first: everything works with zero internet and syncs when the network returns.
- Floor-proof: full function on Android 8+, 2GB RAM and 360px-wide screens; premium experience on flagships and desktop.
- Trust built in: every action is written to a hash-chained audit history (who did what, always), and trustees can publish monthly accounts on a public Transparency Board that any devotee can read — totals and categories only, never donor names.
- One Universal Sanatani ID connects a devotee to every institution they serve.

## Who it is for — 17 organisation types

Mandir, Goshala, Ashram, Gurukul, Vidyalaya, Sangha, Samaj, Satsang, Yoga, Trust, Dharmada Trust, Akshaya Patra, Tirth, Kashi Kshetra, Mahotsav Samiti, Purohit Sabha, and the Purohit (personal workspace) for independent priests. Individuals use Solo Sanatani, the personal devotee app.

## What it includes

14 flagship suites: Goshala One, Pathshala One, Matha One, Ashram One, Annakshetra One, Utsav One, Tirth One, Yoga One, Satsang One, Sabha One, Nyas One, Samskara One, Purohit One, Jyotish One. Plus Sangam (community layer), Seva Bazar (marketplace for booking verified purohits and jyotishis), Cash Custody (hash-chained hundi and cash custody) and Solo Sanatani (personal app). Role-based access: SuperAdmin, Trustee, Accountant, Priest, Purohit, Jyotishi, Sevadar, Devotee.

## Pricing (final, per workspace)

- Seva — free forever: ₹0 · ৳0 · $0. Up to 100 devotees, 2 seats, 1 branch.
- Standard — ₹499 · ৳700 · $6 per month, or ₹4,999 · ৳7,000 · $60 per year. Up to 1,000 devotees, 10 seats, 3 branches.
- Premium — ₹1,999 · ৳2,800 · $24 per month, or ₹19,999 · ৳28,000 · $240 per year. Unlimited devotees, seats and branches.
- Purohit/Jyotishi Pro — ₹199 · ৳280 · $2.50 per month, for independent priests and astrologers.
- Annual billing costs 10 monthly payments (two months free). Payments: Bangladesh by Bangla QR, India by UPI, international by Payoneer or Wise.
- Seva Bazar marketplace commission: 15% for community providers; verified providers pay 8% on Rail-1 and 12% on Rail-2. Religious services are never discounted.

## Languages

10 languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam. Sacred terms are never translated; amounts use Indian lakh/crore formatting.
